title: S10 four-arm/eight-run capacity and command-gap proposal

filesystem_measurement.filesystem_identity: the current local scratch filesystem; mount path redacted

selected_case_tree.measurement_scope: entire selected SS tree staged in the attempt-three shadow; includes auxiliary tables and support files
selected_case_tree.copy_semantics: run_ss_case.py operates in the selected SS tree in place; active input binaries are not copied per run

retained_s15_20_second_run_reference.limits: These are measured S15 references, not S10 output evidence or a finite upper bound for S10 capture logs.

provenance.preprocessed_sources_bytes: Rounded to 200000 bytes per arm from observed generated target source sizes of 175513 bytes (mp37) and 147169 bytes (mp237), each duplicated across B/C.
provenance.object_module_bytes: Rounded to 250000 bytes per arm from observed target object+module pairs of 203024 bytes (mp37) and 204056 bytes (mp237).
provenance.linked_executable_bytes: Two times the measured canonical WRF executable size per arm, four arms total.
provenance.temporary_build_peak_bytes: 300000000-byte planning allowance; twice the measured canonical libtorch build-tree size (127167824 bytes) rounded upward for intermediate build files. This is not an observed S10 build peak.
provenance.input_copy_bytes: Zero per-run copies, based on run_ss_case.py reading the three active inputs from the shared SS tree in place.
provenance.run_staging_bytes: One measured maximum model-output payload during the final logging-on run while run_ss_case.py archives it with copy2.
provenance.run_output_bytes: Four copies per logging mode of the largest measured 20-second S15 model-output payload (637977800 bytes/run).
provenance.logging_off_log_bytes: Four times the measured 93087-byte S15 control-run logs.
provenance.logging_on_log_bytes: Four times the largest measured 478042-byte S15 capture-run logs; S10 event logging has no established maximum, so this is only a proxy and not an upper bound.
provenance.shared_staging_components: The entire measured attempt-three SS tree plus eight times the largest measured per-run metadata bundle. The SS tree is already staged and is included in current free-space measurement.

estimator_contract_nuance.required_resolution: A reviewed estimator-contract change must distinguish already-present, hash-bound staged case bytes from future incremental allocations before capacity approval.

lossless_compression_diagnostic.operation: stream-only tar to zstd level 1 to byte counter; no archive file created
lossless_compression_diagnostic.sample_scope: one retained 20-second S15 capture-reference run directory

duplicate_inventory.scope: output/log files in one retained S15 case tree compared by SHA-256 with its archived run directories
duplicate_inventory.potential_reclamation_status: owner review required; no files removed

read_only_make_dry_run_inventory.source: successful attempt-three configure.wrf plus current shadow Makefiles; paths redacted
read_only_make_dry_run_inventory.default_link_template: time mpif90 -o wrf.exe $(LDFLAGS) wrf.o wrf_kdm6ad_exit.o ../main/module_wrf_top.o libwrflib.a $(CMAQLIB) $(LIB)
mismatches_that_block_normalized_argv_re: Default link output is relative main/wrf.exe, not the arm-specific S10/build-clean executable path.
Default LIBWRFLIB resolves to a shadow-local relative libwrflib.a, not the exact canonical archive path and SHA required by the plan.
Required standard link objects are absent from the fresh shadow.
Default preprocessor/compile flags do not include KDM6_PROGB_VALIDITY_CAPTURE or KDM6_PROGB_POLICY_MIDPOINT, and do not express the B-absent/C-present ZERO_QG_DIV_GUARD one-factor delta.
The local KDM6 C library is absent; make -n exposes a CMake build/install prerequisite that must be included in a reviewed resource/command plan.

safe_next_step_options: Measure a separate volume and place the disposable build/run workspace there under a revised reviewed path-bound plan, preserving the current S15/S10 evidence.
Alternatively propose lossless per-run archives with a per-file size/SHA manifest and a tested exact restore-and-reverify path; revise the runner/plan and review it before any retention change.
Sequential execution reduces transient duplicate output peaks but does not reduce the total eight-run retained output requirement.
Do not reclaim the exact duplicate working-tree files or alter any archived run directory without a separate evidence-owner review.
